text:
Maya (product): Quick heads-up — we are GA-ing the new Hosted Realtime Tooling (streaming tool-calling) tomorrow 08:00 UTC. This brings the streaming toolcall endpoint + model variants (mosaic-lite/standard/pro) into GA for hosted customers.
Sam (eng-runtime): Awesome. Are we flagging any required client changes?
Maya (product): Minimal. Clients should switch from /v1/stream-tool to /v1/realtime/toolcall and update the streaming handshake header: 
```
Client: Authorization: Bearer <key>\nClient: x-rw-realtime: v1
```
Sam (eng-runtime): +1. The SDKs (js + py) will auto-map old call to new endpoint for 3 weeks via compatibility proxy; we still prefer explicit migration.
Lee (devex): I'll ship the migration guide and a small compatibility-snippet in the quickstart. Will post an announcement in docs shortly.
Jin (eng-sre): Ops notes: we will enable canary in us-west-2 first, then eu-west-1 24h later. Auto-fallback policy: if realtime capacity is saturated, requests fall back to streaming-toolcall-compat with 5s added latency.
Maya (product): Important policy change: GA customers will be subject to new per-connection limits to preserve latency SLOs. Limits: 150 concurrent streams per org by default. Request increases via support.
Evelyn (support): I'll update the support SOP and canned replies. Also prepping a list of customers hitting the alpha who we should proactively notify.
Sam (eng-runtime): Known issues to call out: 1) KV-cache warmup causes a short burst of CPU on first long-context requests; mitigation: pre-warm on rollout. 2) Some legacy models in catalog don't support toolcall structured output — the API will now return 422 for unsupported combos.
Maya (product): Migration checklist for eng teams:
- Update client header to x-rw-realtime: v1
- Switch endpoint to /v1/realtime/toolcall or rely on SDK mapping for short term
- Validate tool metadata JSON schema against the new strict typing (see docs link)
- Run smoke tests against canary region
Sam (eng-runtime): CI snippet for smoke test: 
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -H "x-rw-realtime: v1" \
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-pro","tools":[{"name":"search","schema":{}}],"prompt":"find docs"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/realtime/toolcall
```
Jin (eng-sre): Monitoring hooks: enable per-org stream_count and stream_latency dashboards. Alert if 95p latency > 220ms or active_streams > 120% of quota.
Lee (devex): I'll create a short migration snippet we can paste into customer repos and a sample recorded session to show expected behavior.
Maya (product): Rollout timeline summary: tomorrow 08:00 UTC canary us-west-2; 24h monitoring; 08:00 UTC +24h promote eu-west-1; 72h global promote if no critical regressions.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: realtime-toolcall-ga-canary -> us-west-2 by Sam (eng-runtime) at 1863000300
Sam (eng-runtime): Deploy completed to canary at 1863000450. Basic smoke tests passed. Watching metrics.
Jin (eng-sre): Observability: saw a small spike in token-controller CPU during warmups, back to baseline after 6 minutes. No error budget burn.
Evelyn (support): Reached out to top 10 alpha users with the migration doc + scheduled webinar link.
Maya (product): Thanks team. If you own any SDKs, docs, or support flows please post status updates in this thread. Will follow up with a postmortem if any incidents occur during rollout. :rocket:
